title: browser.handover
description: Bridge -> host. Hands control of the browser to the user. Answered by browser.handover.ok, or by browser.response with status error. A frame without a usable req_id is dropped without reply.

req_id.description: Unique, generated by the bridge; same id space as browser.request.

note.description: Optional short sentence shown to the user. Omitted when empty.

examples.note: Please complete the sign-in, then tap Done.
